items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: every time I see Bill Cosby, Bill Cosby says, “Nefertiti. Nefertiti.”

ctx.x: She had – I don’t know whether you would call it a psychic memory or what, but she had an intuition. Bill Cosby – every time I see Bill Cosby, Bill Cosby says, “Nefertiti. Nefertiti.” I said, “What do you mean, Nefertiti?” He said, “Pearl used to call me Nefertiti. I used to say, ‘Pearl, what do you mean, Nefertiti?’” She said, “That was the name of the girl that you had when you went to high school.” He said, “Yeah, I guess that’s right.” Nefertiti. That’s how things happened with Pearl. She came up with all…
Did she know Bill Cosby in high school?
